title: Data Engineer, New Grad, Data Platform
description_text:
Job ID: R-4471

Example Co builds route-planning software for regional freight carriers. You will join the Data Platform team, which owns the pipelines that feed pricing, dispatch and billing. You'll report to the Engineering Manager, Data Platform.

What you will do

- Build and run batch pipelines in Python and Airflow
- Model warehouse tables in dbt and Snowflake

What we look for

- Python and SQL
- Experience with Airflow or a similar scheduler

Example Co is an equal opportunity employer.
